message.reasoning_content: Now verify: read file, and check other sections unchanged. Since only one line changed per diff, good. Let me verify with awk/grep that dev and prod retries are still 3, staging is 5. Also maybe compare git diff if repo.

function.name: shell
function.arguments: {"command": "echo \"=== file ===\"; cat -A app.ini; echo \"=== per-section retries ===\"; awk '/^\\[/{s=$0} /^retries/{print s, $0}' app.ini; echo \"=== git diff ===\"; git diff -- app.ini 2>&1 | head -40; echo \"exit=$?\""}
